name: Shopping in a Winter Zombieland
source:
Christmas spirit during the zombie apocalypse: you could put on your Santa costume on Christmas Eve. But that's not all it's supposed to be. You roam through an abandoned shopping center in search of Christmas presents and a forgotten reindeer sleigh. When Christmas music lures zombies, you have to make momentous decisions.

You can expect seven endings, German voice-overs, and hand-drawn characters and backgrounds. A visual novel from the world of Zombie Zone Germany, a German literature and role-playing game series from Amrûn Publishing.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2673160/Shopping_in_a_Winter_Zombieland/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
僵尸大灾难期间的圣诞节精神：你可以在平安夜穿上圣诞老人服装。但这并不是它应该的全部。你漫步在一个废弃的购物中心，寻找圣诞礼物和被遗忘的驯鹿雪橇。当圣诞音乐引诱僵尸时，你必须做出重大决定。

你可以期待七个结局、德语配音以及手绘角色和背景。来自德国僵尸地带世界的视觉小说，Amrûn Publishing的德国文学和角色扮演游戏系列。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2673160/Shopping_in_a_Winter_Zombieland/]Steam[/url]]
